detail.title: Institutional Journal: Autocatalytic Memory and Heredity Thresholds Research
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on autocatalytic reaction network topology and their capacity for memory storage and evolutionary heredity. Revisions establish that global behavior and evolutionary potential in prebiotic systems arise from specific stoichiometric subgraphs and the aggregation of local interaction bounds.

children.title: Copying Fidelity and Compositional Stability in Evolving Prebiotic Systems

detail.title: Copying Fidelity and Compositional Stability in Evolving Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: Stable heredity in prebiotic chemical systems requires balancing copying fidelity with the compositional stability afforded by structural subgraphs. Hereditary evolution emerges not merely from persistence, but from the network's ability to maintain functional stoichiometry through aggregated local interactions.
detail.reason: Notebook revision to connect heredity potential to the structural network stability characterized in recently retrieved stoichiometric evidence.
